meta.name: When the Stars Gossip
meta.description: From two different worlds and with separate missions, an astronaut and a space tourist entangle in space — only to start falling for each other.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Coming from two different backgrounds, Gong Ryong and Eve Kim embark on a space mission. But trouble strikes after launch, jeopardizing their expedition.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Upon arriving in space, Ryong panics as Eve threatens to ruin his secret mission. Shortly after, a crisis emerges, forcing Ryong to attempt a novel feat.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Determined to carry out the secret mission himself, Ryong tries to circumvent Kang Kang-su. During a space walk, Eve experiences a sudden problem.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: With Eve's life in jeopardy, Ryong watches helplessly — as protocol prevents him from saving her. With every passing second, she loses precious oxygen.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Following Ryong's sudden confession, Eve discovers a hurtful truth unfolding back on Earth. Soon, she learns of an even more disturbing reality in space.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Eve discovers an unethical secret, forcing her to act decisively despite Ryong's objection — which drives him to take matters into his own hands.
